title: VMware migration reduces Tottenham Hotspur's licensing fees by 85 percent
summary: Tottenham Hotspur football club successfully migrated their IT infrastructure away from VMware, achieving an 85 percent reduction in licensing fees. This migration is part of a broader trend where organizations are seeking alternatives to VMware following Broadcom's acquisition and subsequent pricing changes.
problem_solved: Addresses the problem of excessive VMware licensing costs that have skyrocketed following Broadcom's acquisition of VMware.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a real-world 85% cost reduction case study, showing organizations can achieve significant savings while maintaining reliable IT infrastructure through strategic vendor migration.
